ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported a challenging Q1 FY27 with significant declines in profitability metrics both year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter, driven by substantial margin compression. Consolidated EBITDA fell 10% Y-o-Y and 19% Q-o-Q, alongside a 5% Y-o-Y and 15% Q-o-Q drop in PAT. This performance, despite a modest 2% Y-o-Y revenue growth, is a red flag primarily due to a 7% Y-o-Y decline in the crucial Human Nutrition segment's revenue, specifically from lower Pharma/API sales.
